messages:
PagerBot: [ALERT] suspicious auth header pattern detected from multiple edge proxies (burst ~120/min). correlator sample: glimmer_7f3a...
Ava: seeing same in staging and prod? anyone customer-facing hit?
Ravi: prod only, started ~09:12 UTC, small burst to auth endpoint /v1/session
Miguel: attaching a tiny log snippet i pulled from edge-3 so we can triage quickly
Miguel: ```
# truncated log sample
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z src=edge-3 auth_header="Bearer glimmer_7f3a2b" path=/v1/session status=200 client_ip=34.12.56.78
2026-03-17T09:12:35Z src=edge-7 auth_header="Bearer glimmer_8a9d0c" path=/v1/session status=200 client_ip=34.12.56.79
```
Leah: looks like token fragments (not full long-lived keys). could be telemetry/log leak, but treat as potential secret exposure. marking P0 and paging sec-eng.
Ava: @Ravi you're oncall for auth — can you confirm rate limiter + blocklist status?
Ravi: on it. increasing rate-limit to 100/min for /v1/session and adding WAF rule to drop headers matching `glimmer_` now.
SecBot: Temporary WAF rule applied id=wr-993 at 09:17 UTC. blocked_count=34 so far.
Miguel: running a quick search for other occurrences and whether any logs were forwarded externally
Miguel: command I ran: `grep -R "glimmer_" /var/log/redwood | head -n 50`
Ava: if any logs were shipped to external buckets we need urgent rotation. @Leah coordinate security playbook for rotation + legal.
Leah: initiating rotation plan: 1) rotate service tokens used by auth-proxies 2) invalidate sessions older than 24h 3) preserve and scrub logs, escalate to Legal if customer secrets found.
Ravi: beginning service-token rotation across auth-proxy fleet; rolling canary now, ETA ~25m.
Ava: any customer impact so far? 401s, login failures?
Miguel: small uptick in 401 after WAF applied, region us-west-2 shows ~0.2% increase in login failures for a 5m window, no broad customer outages detected.
Leah: drafting customer notification template: short, factual, no alarm, we rotated internal service tokens and are investigating potential log exposure. will send to comms for approval.
Miguel: I'll preserve raw logs to a locked bucket (retention override) and start redaction job to remove glimmer_* fragments before wider access.
Miguel: redaction quick script: ```python
import re
for line in open('raw.log'):
  print(re.sub(r'glimmer_[0-9a-f]+','<REDACTED>', line))
```
SecBot: Legal notified (ticket SEC-2026-31). evidence preserved; audit trail recorded.
Ravi: token rotation completed for initial canary nodes at 09:42 UTC. rolling to full pool now.
Ava: owners & next steps: Miguel (logs + scrub), Leah (security coordination + customer comms), Ravi (rollout completion + validation). please update incident doc.
Leah: opening incident runbook and will attach curator notes + escalation timeline. tagging incident as security (S2) until we confirm customer secret exposure.
Miguel: follow-up: I'll run a scan across all buckets for glimmer_* artifacts and report back with scope.
Ava: thanks team. if blocked_count from WAF goes above 10/min reopen active response. otherwise move to monitoring and schedule postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
PagerBot: Active response moved to monitoring state. reopen condition: >10 hits/min or any confirmed leaked customer secrets. 09:55 UTC
